connector.name: Fonteum - Healthcare Provider Data
connector.registryDescription: Source-provenanced US federal healthcare provider data over MCP, with 14-tuple provenance.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the npm package mcp. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the fonteum account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: FONTEUM_API_KEY
env.description: Fonteum API key. Defaults to the free read-only demo key pk_dx_sample (100 req/hour/IP, no signup).

env.name: FONTEUM_API_BASE
env.description: Override the REST API base URL (self-hosted / staging).
